data.nominating_party_note: Fillmore accepted the presidential nomination of the American Party (Know-Nothing), and the Whig Party endorsed him. This dataset treats that endorsement as a Whig nomination. This dataset's sources do not name a convention, caucus or other body that nominated or endorsed him.

Brown was Horace Greeley's running mate in 1872. Greeley died before the electors voted, and electors in several states then voted for various candidates. Some voted for Brown for President.
Horace Greeley died before the electors voted in 1872, and electors in several states then voted for various candidates. Two Georgia electors voted for Jenkins for President.

Greeley was nominated for President by both the Liberal Republicans and the Democrats. He died on November 29, 1872, before the electors met. After his death, electors in several states split their votes.

The Democrats and the Liberal Republicans nominated Horace Greeley for President in 1872. Greeley died before the electors voted, and electors in several states then voted for various candidates. Some voted for Hendricks for President.

provenance.redistributable_note: Redistributable data only. Electoral-college figures come from the U.S. National Archives and Records Administration — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105) — and cover every election in the snapshot. Popular-vote figures come from MIT Election Lab under CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication) and cover 1976–2024 only; earlier elections carry no popular vote on this surface, and each row's `pv_status` says whether that is because none was held or because no redistributable source reaches it. Per-capita population figures come from the U.S. Census Bureau — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Nominating parties come from the same Electoral College source, or, where a row's `nominating_party_source` is `USGOV`, from U.S. Government publications — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Non-redistributable UCSB / American Presidency Project data is excluded from this public API surface.
